candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its POST /v1/orders call to the order service fails with transport errors at ~2s, indicating order-service unavailability or timeout.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-service side logs/metrics absent; cannot distinguish order-service hang vs. its own downstream (inventory/payment/postgresql) latency.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show consistent 502s on /v1/checkout paired with transport errors calling order at ~2s, while /readyz stays 200. Root cause is downstream of the gateway at the order service, but the specific failing dependency is not yet established.
missing_evidence: Order-service logs and metrics for POST /v1/orders latency and errors
Order-service downstream dependency metrics (inventory, payment, postgresql) to localize the ~2s stall
